title: A member who joins online is never asked for a birthday, so the birthday wish skips them
what: The gym's join page asks for name, mobile, gender and plan, but not the date of birth. When the desk turns the request into a member, the Add member form is filled with the name, number and gender only. Unless the desk asks and types the birthday, the member never gets the birthday wish or shows under Birthdays today.
expected: The join page asks for the date of birth (optional), and it is carried into the new member, so online joiners get the same birthday wish as desk joiners.
who: members who join online, and owners counting on the wish
fix_line: Add an optional birthday box to the join page and carry it into the new member

title: The price and discount boxes on ready offer messages drop the decimal point
what: On Messages & offers, the price, saving and discount boxes keep only the digits. A pasted '1499.00' becomes 149900, so the offer reads Rs 1,49,900 a month; a discount typed as 7.5 becomes 75% off. A number typed on a Hindi keyboard is thrown away and the box stays empty. The owner can see the wrong number in the box, but nothing warns them before it goes to every member.
expected: A price with paise is read as rupees (or refused with a plain line), a part-percent discount is refused or rounded with a word, and Hindi digits count as digits.
who: owners writing an offer to all members
how_often: rare: a price pasted with .00 or a half-percent discount
fix_line: Read these boxes with the shared rupee reader and refuse a decimal discount in words
